issue.title: Link-form reuse of a completed multi-word Pomodoro name authors a hyphenated spelling (DEEP WORK → DEEP-WORK)
issue.description:
Scratch vault (BOB_NOW=2026-10-24T10:00, BOB_DAY_FILE pointing at it) whose `## Pomodoros` holds a completed `- [x] (**0920-0950** [t:: 30m]) — DEEP WORK` plus an inbox note with task `^foo1`:

- `bob capture --bob-dir <vault> -d '=#deep-work'` (start form) → `would start … DEEP WORK` (spelling kept; the start path reuses the CompletedOnly entry's name).
- `bob capture --bob-dir <vault> -d '@inbox_t:foo1#deep-work'` (link form) → `Linked under DEEP-WORK · created DEEP-WORK` (spelling lost).

Root cause: `select_named` returns `CompletedOnly(entry)`, and `capture_task_toggle/ledger.rs` routes it to `plan_created_named_entry` → `relocation.rs::insert_named_placeholder`, which names the new entry `canonicalize_pomodoro_name(selector)`, so the slug `deep-work` becomes `DEEP-WORK`. The start path (`capture/pomodoro_start.rs`, the `CompletedOnly(entry)` arm near line 1102) already prefers `entry.name`. The same `canonicalize_pomodoro_name(selector)` pattern also appears in `capture/pomodoro_insert.rs:261` (`insert_named_pomodoro_child_block`) and `capture/pomodoro_link.rs` around line 1085. Audit those for the same CompletedOnly case.

Fix: when the selection is `CompletedOnly(entry)`, name the new entry with the completed entry's canonical name, for every creating path (link, child-block insert, start). Add a regression test per path with a multi-word completed name.

task_type_fields.impact: Silently forks a theme into a hyphenated twin the moment a spaced name is reused through the link form. The live vault already shows this: on 2026-10-08 an open `— SASE-V18` placeholder sits below four completed `— SASE V18` sessions. The plan budget then counts two themes, Stats splits the history, and the planned Pomodoro theme catalog would show both spellings. 18 of the vault's 86 distinct Pomodoro names contain spaces.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/capture_task_toggle/relocation.rs::insert_named_placeholder (also audit capture/pomodoro_insert.rs:261 and capture/pomodoro_link.rs CompletedOnly arm)

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching Pomodoro themes: the link-form creation path loses a completed name's spelling, which already forked SASE V18 into SASE-V18 in the live vault and would undermine history-based theme suggestions.

payload.description: Both touch how Bob spells a reused Pomodoro start/name token; a fix here should keep the short start tokens consistent
